# DUMB Latest release documentation (2.23.0)

> Channel: release. Canonical base: https://dumbarr.com/

Documentation artifact: release 1.25.21. Source commit: 7980eacd1aa86673d3d1b2eb1bf0f6fccccf7dd7. Release notes: https://github.com/I-am-PUID-0/DUMB_docs/releases/tag/1.25.21.

DUMB coordinates media services. Match instructions to the installed backend version. Development guides can describe features absent from the latest release.
